g.text: 10,000 is the predeclared WSD decay boundary. Full-history overview and all public observations remain available.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: P1/P2 use a fixed ~1M-label native validation slice; their full ~10M-label HF evaluations are separate. One predeclared seed (42); descriptive only.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: P1/P2 cutoff applies to a–c only. Compute uses padded positions with document-aware attention; C shows raw endpoint dots and parameter increments vs B.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: C: A = per-visit attention; R = per-visit router; experts and norms remain shared. Its step-2,048 endpoints are independent of the P1/P2 cutoff.
